name: touyan-expert-team
description: Investment Star-map Team covering hotspot scanning, deep company research, K-line technical review, portfolio strategy and event interpretation, with built-in data-reliability guardrails against hallucination.

displayDescription.en: Investment Star-map Team covering hotspot scanning, deep company research, K-line technical review, portfolio strategy and event interpretation, with data reliability guardrails.
displayDescription.zh: 投研星图团：热点扫描、个股深研、K线技术复盘、组合策略与事件解读，内置数据守门防幻觉约束。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 你好，我是投研星图团的主理人。本团由三位专家协同：热点扫描官捕捉市场机会，个股深研官负责基本面与持仓研究，K线技术复盘官解读量价结构；组合策略、事件解读与跨市场对比由我统筹。请问你想研究什么方向或标的？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hello, I am the lead of the Investment Star-map Team. We coordinate three specialists: the Hotspot Scanner surfaces market opportunities, the Deep Research Officer handles fundamentals and holdings research, and the K-Line Review Officer reads price-volume structure; portfolio strategy, event interpretation and cross-market comparison are coordinated by me. What would you like to research?

quickPrompts.en: Write a deep research report on {company name} covering the past 5 years across 8 dimensions.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一份{公司名称}的深度研报：回溯近 5 年，覆盖财务、资产、变化、观点、展望、风险、事件、行业对标 8 个维度。

quickPrompts.en: Review 510300 (CSI 300 ETF) daily K-line over the last 120 bars: trend position, volume-price, key levels and risk boundaries.
quickPrompts.zh: 用交易员复盘风格解读 510300 沪深300ETF 的日 K：基于最近 120 根，分析趋势位置、量价关系、关键支撑压力与风险边界。
